name: Microsoft

eyebrow.en: Microsoft Corporation · Common stock · Redmond, Washington
eyebrow.zh: 微软 · 普通股 · 华盛顿州雷德蒙德

title.en: Azure accelerates, and the cash still flows.
title.zh: Azure 加速，现金照样流入。

lede.en: Microsoft grew revenue 18% to $90.0B last quarter as Azure accelerated to 43%, and it guides to about 45% next. Unlike most AI spenders it still produces large free cash flow, $67B last fiscal year, even with about $41B of quarterly capex including leases.
lede.zh: 微软上季营收增 18% 至 900 亿美元，Azure 增速加快至 43%，下季指引约 45%。与多数 AI 投资者不同，即使含租赁的季度资本开支约 410 亿美元，它仍产生大量自由现金流，上财年为 670 亿。

s.zh: FY27 Q1 增速，按固定汇率
FY27 第一季 · 预计，盘后

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $349 to $554 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $349 至 $554 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30. Some GAAP EPS figures include OpenAI-related items. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。微软财年截至6月30日。部分 GAAP 每股收益含 OpenAI 相关项目。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 扣除 1159 亿现金资本开支后

p.en: Azure grew 43% and is guided to about 45%, with demand still ahead of supply. Azure passed $100B of annual revenue.
p.zh: Azure 增长 43%，指引约 45%，需求仍超供给。Azure 年收入突破 1000 亿美元。

p.en: Paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats doubled to over 30M.
p.zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot 付费席位翻倍至逾 3000 万。

p.en: About $50B of capex is expected in Q1 FY27 and fiscal 2027 spending will rise. Gross margin slipped to 67%.
p.zh: FY27 第一季资本开支预计约 500 亿美元，FY27 全年将上升。毛利率降至 67%。

p.en: Much of the $678B backlog is OpenAI; excluding it, backlog grew 25%.
p.zh: 6780 亿积压订单中很大部分来自 OpenAI；剔除后增长 25%。
指引：营收 898.5–909.5 亿美元，Azure 增约 45%。

p.en: Management expects capex to grow in fiscal 2027.
p.zh: 管理层预计 FY27 资本开支增长。

sources: Q4 FY26 recap: FCF and capex
Price, market cap, beta and earnings date: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Microsoft Corporation.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Microsoft Corporation 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q1 FY22 to Q4 FY26. Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 20 个季度。微软财年截至6月30日。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Microsoft has produced positive free cash flow in all 20 quarters, usually $15–25B, with a seasonal dip in the December quarter when taxes are paid. Cash capex more than doubled in two years, from $44.5B in FY24 to $115.9B in FY26, yet FY26 free cash flow was still $67B because operating cash flow grew almost as fast.
read.zh: 微软 20 个季度自由现金流全部为正，通常 150–250 亿美元，12月季度因缴税季节性走低。两年内现金资本开支由 FY24 的 445 亿增至 FY26 的 1159 亿，翻倍有余，但经营现金流几乎同步增长，FY26 自由现金流仍达 670 亿美元。

read.en: Management expects about $50B of capex in Q1 FY27 including leases, and higher spending through fiscal 2027. I assume cash capex of $42–47B a quarter against operating cash flow of $40–62B, giving about $29B over four quarters, much less than FY26 and roughly what the dividend costs.
read.zh: 管理层预计 FY27 第一季含租赁资本开支约 500 亿美元，全年支出更高。我假设每季现金资本开支 420–470 亿、经营现金流 400–620 亿，四季合计约 290 亿美元，远低于 FY26，约等于股息支出。

p.en: $115.9B of cash capex in FY26 plus finance leases; Q4 capex including leases was about $41B.
p.zh: FY26 现金资本开支 1159 亿美元，另有融资租赁；第四季含租赁资本开支约 410 亿。
近期每季约 46 亿美元。

p.en: Operating cash flow of $55.4B in Q4, up 30%.
p.zh: 第四季经营现金流 554 亿美元，增 30%。

p.en: $678B of commercial RPO, about 30% due within 12 months.
p.zh: 商业剩余履约义务 6780 亿美元，约 30% 在 12 个月内确认。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes debt maturities and new borrowing.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入债务到期及新增借款。

extraNote.en: Capex here is cash purchases of property and equipment; management's capex figure also includes finance leases.
extraNote.zh: 此处资本开支为物业与设备的现金购置；管理层口径另含融资租赁。
